output_list.code: function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) realUser(_to) moreThanZero(_value) public returns (bool)
output_list.reason: The function does not properly check for overflow when updating the balance of the sender. If an attacker can manipulate the _to address to be a contract that has a fallback function, they can exploit this vulnerability to cause an overflow, leading to potential loss of funds.

output_list.code: function approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) moreThanZero(_value) public returns (bool success)
output_list.reason: Similar to the transfer function, the approve function does not check for overflow when updating the allowance. An attacker can exploit this by setting a very high _value, leading to an overflow and potentially allowing them to approve more tokens than the owner intended.

output_list.code: function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) realUser(_from) realUser(_to) moreThanZero(_value) public returns (bool success)
output_list.reason: The function does not check for overflow when updating the balance of the recipient. If _to is a contract, an attacker can exploit this by causing an overflow, leading to potential loss of funds.
